course.title: Site and Area Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: You are an urban planner tasked with evaluating the impact of a new 10-meter- (10) tall building on its neighboring park for solar access. You need to calculate the length of the shadow cast by this building at noon on the winter solstice. Assume you are located at a latitude where the sun's elevation angle (the angle above the horizon) at noon on the winter solstice is 30 degrees.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
